steps.title: Extract total RNA with Trizol
steps.instruction: Homogenize rat brain tissue in Trizol reagent (Invitrogen, USA) and isolate total RNA according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Isolate miRNA from tissue
steps.instruction: Purify miRNA from the same rat brain tissue using the miRNA purification kit (CW0627S, CWBIO, China) following the kit instructions.

steps.title: Measure RNA purity and concentration
steps.instruction: Determine RNA concentration and purity with an NP80 UV spectrophotometer (NanoPhotometer, Germany); accept samples with OD260/OD280 ratios between 1.8 and 2.0.

steps.title: Reverse transcribe miRNA
steps.instruction: Convert the isolated miRNA to cDNA using the miRNA 1st Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit (stem‑loop) (MR101-02, Vazyme, China) as directed by the manufacturer.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: Set up qPCR reactions with miRNA Universal SYBR qPCR Master Mix (MQ101-02, Vazyme, China) on a CFX Connect™ fluorescence PCR system (Bio‑Rad, USA).

steps.title: Run qPCR cycling program
steps.instruction: Program the cycler: pre‑denaturation 95 °C for 10 min; denaturation 95 °C for 10 s; annealing 58 °C for 30 s; extension 72 °C for 30 s; repeat for 40 cycles.

steps.title: Analyze qPCR data
steps.instruction: Perform each reaction in triplicate, use U6 as internal reference, and calculate relative gene expression with the 2^-ΔΔCT method (primer sequences are listed in Table 1).

steps.title: Collect and centrifuge serum
steps.instruction: Collect rat serum and centrifuge at 1000 g for 20 min to obtain clear supernatant.

steps.title: Equilibrate ELISA kit
steps.instruction: Allow the ELISA kit (ExCell Biology, Shanghai, China) to reach room temperature before use.

steps.title: Prepare ELISA standards
steps.instruction: Prepare standard solutions according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Add samples and reagents to plate
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of each standard or serum sample to the appropriate wells (blank wells receive no sample); then add 100 µL of enzyme‑labelled reagent to every well.

steps.title: Incubate ELISA plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 1 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash and develop ELISA
steps.instruction: Wash wells five times, add chromogenic substrate, incubate 15 min at 37 °C, then add stop solution.

steps.title: Read ELISA absorbance
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance of each well at 450 nm using a plate reader.

steps.title: Homogenize hippocampal tissue
steps.instruction: Collect rat hippocampus, homogenize in RIPA lysis buffer containing protease and phosphatase inhibitors using a tissue homogenizer.

steps.title: Centrifuge homogenate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate at 12,000 rpm, 4 °C for 10 min and collect the supernatant as total protein extract.

steps.title: Quantify protein concentration
steps.instruction: Determine protein concentration with a BCA protein assay kit according to the kit protocol.

steps.title: Separate proteins by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Denature proteins and load onto an SDS‑PAGE gel; run electrophoresis for 1.5 h.

steps.title: Transfer proteins to PVDF membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins to a PVDF membrane (Millipore) at a constant 300 mA: NRG1 for 1 h, ErbB4/TLR4/NLRP3 for 2 h, ASC for 0.5 h.

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Block the PVDF membrane with non‑fat milk (5 % w/v) for an appropriate time at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate the blocked membrane with the appropriate primary antibody at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: After washing, incubate the membrane with HRP‑conjugated secondary antibody at room temperature for 2 h.

steps.title: Detect chemiluminescence
steps.instruction: Apply chemiluminescent substrate, visualize bands using a high‑sensitivity chemiluminescence imaging system.

steps.title: Analyze band intensity
steps.instruction: Quantify band intensities with Image J software and normalize target protein expression to β‑actin as the internal reference.
